Real Speech Recorder

Records real (non-TTS) speech. Two prompt sets, picked with the toggle on the left: Real audio (10 items → backend/tests/fixtures/real_audio/, for run_real_audio_report.py) and Realtime quality corpus (all 33 interpreter_dataset.json items → backend/tests/fixtures/realtime_quality/, for the Realtime-mode LLM-judge run; see SCRIPT.md there). Pick a prompt, record it, listen back, then save. Output is already the exact format the pipeline expects (mono 16-bit PCM WAV, 16000Hz) — no ffmpeg conversion needed.

Opened directly as a local file. This works in Chrome/Edge, but if the recorder doesn't respond (prompts don't select, or Record does nothing), some browsers block microphone access on file:// pages entirely. Fix: from the repo root, run npx --yes serve backend/tests/fixtures/real_audio and open the http://localhost:... URL it prints instead.
No folder access yet. Click Grant repo access below and select the repo root folder (boostlingo_v2) — recordings save directly into place and the manifest updates itself. Without it, you can still record and download each file manually.
